title: Non-overlapping Intervals
description:
Given an array of `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [start, end]`, return the **minimum number of intervals you must remove** so that the remaining intervals do not overlap.

Intervals that only touch at an endpoint, like `[1,2]` and `[2,3]`, do **not** overlap.

examples.explanation: Remove [1,3] and the rest do not overlap.

hints: Equivalently, keep as many intervals as possible.
Greedy: sort by end time and always keep the interval that ends earliest, skipping any that starts before the last kept end.
